# Introduction

Describe what the package is for and who would use it.

# Installation

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("waldronlab/MyPackage")
```

# Usage

```{r usage}
library(MyPackage)
hello("world")
```
